_comment: Per-page Arabic <title>, meta description and og:* strings. These have no data-i18n equivalent because they live in the <head>, so they are keyed by repo-relative source path. build_ar.py --check fails if any page in pages.json with ar:true is missing an entry here. Written by hand, not machine-translated: title tags are the highest-SEO-value strings on the site and Arabic that reads like machine output reads that way to a Saudi buyer too.
